learning_outcomes.text: Is able to analyse the operation of devices and compare the construction solutions applying usage, safety, environmental, economic and legal criteria
Possesses knowledge on mechanics, including the processes of modelling mechanical systems, statics, kinematics and dynamics of rigid objects and basic knowledge on vibrations

Is able to identify, formulate and develop the documentation of a simple design or technological task, including the description of the results of this task in Polish or in a foreign language and to present the results using computer software or other aiding tools
Is able to design a typical construction of a mechanical device, component or a testing station using appropriate methods and tools, adhering to the set usage criteria
Possesses basic knowledge including the methodology of designing machine parts, mechanical devices, selection of construction materials, manufacturing and operation, with the lifetime cycle

syllabus_topics: General theoretical foundations (features, functions, constructional variants, application, etc.) regarding typical groups of machine parts, such as: screw joints, welded joints, shafts and axles, couplings, gears, brakes, bearings, drives, flexible elements
Basic calculation methods of typical machine elements
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the final exam, tests, and design projects is 56.0%.
bibliography: A set of scripts from the Basics of Machine Design published by the Gdańsk University of Technology
A set of books "Basics of Machine Design" published by PWN, Warsaw
"PKM, t. I, II, III" edited by M. Dietrich, PWN, Warsaw
Any works on the "Basics of Machine Design" in Polish and English
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
